title: Core Utility Functions
summary: This module provides essential utility functions for file downloads, asynchronous program execution, callback management, and dummy components for testing. It facilitates core DSPy operations and development workflows.

nodes.label: Download File
nodes.title: File Downloader
nodes.description: Downloads a file from a given URL, checking for existing files and resuming if partially downloaded. Ensures file integrity by comparing sizes.

nodes.label: Apply Experimental Decorator
nodes.title: Experimental Feature Annotation
nodes.description: A decorator factory that marks functions as experimental, optionally specifying a version. Used for managing feature stability and warnings.

nodes.label: Wrap Program for Execution
nodes.title: Program Execution Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps a program's execution to manage thread-local overrides, ensuring that specific settings are applied and reset correctly during its lifecycle.

nodes.label: Run Program Asynchronously
nodes.title: Asynchronous Program Execution
nodes.description: Executes a given program asynchronously in a separate thread, applying thread-local overrides and respecting a global concurrency limiter. Essential for non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: Get Concurrency Limiter
nodes.title: Asynchronous Concurrency Control
nodes.description: Provides a global `CapacityLimiter` instance to control the maximum number of concurrent asynchronous operations, preventing resource exhaustion.

nodes.label: Wrap Async Function with Callbacks
nodes.title: Asynchronous Callback Management
nodes.description: A decorator that wraps asynchronous functions to execute registered callbacks before and after the function's execution, handling call IDs and exceptions.

nodes.label: Wrap Sync Function with Callbacks
nodes.title: Synchronous Callback Management
nodes.description: A decorator that wraps synchronous functions to execute registered callbacks before and after the function's execution, managing call IDs and exceptions.

nodes.label: Simulate Language Model
nodes.title: Mock Language Model for Testing
nodes.description: A mock language model implementation for testing purposes. It can return predefined responses from a list, a dictionary based on prompt content, or follow example outputs.

nodes.label: Simulate Retriever Logic
nodes.title: Mock Retriever for Testing
nodes.description: A dummy function simulating a retriever's core logic, returning a subset of passages based on a query and a specified number of results (k). Used for testing retrieval components.

nodes.label: Synchronize Async Program
nodes.title: Async Program Synchronizer
nodes.description: A wrapper class that allows an asynchronous program (specifically one with an `aforward` method) to be called synchronously, facilitating integration into synchronous contexts.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: BaseLM Interface
nodes.description: The foundational interface for all language models in DSPy, defining common methods and properties.

nodes.label: Thread-Local Settings
nodes.title: DSPy Thread-Local Settings
nodes.description: Manages thread-specific configuration overrides for DSPy components, ensuring isolated settings for concurrent operations.

nodes.label: Chat Adapter
nodes.title: Chat Message Formatting
nodes.description: Adapts messages to and from a chat-based format, handling roles and content for language model interactions.

groups.label: Data Handling
groups.title: Data Acquisition & Management
groups.description: Components focused on acquiring and managing external data.

groups.label: Execution Control & Monitoring
groups.title: Program Flow & Observability
groups.description: Utilities for controlling program execution flow, managing concurrency, and integrating callbacks for monitoring.

groups.label: Program Execution Utilities
groups.title: Core Program Execution
groups.description: Fundamental utilities for running DSPy programs, including asynchronous execution and bridging async/sync contexts.

groups.label: Mock Components for Testing
groups.title: Simulated Generative Models
groups.description: Dummy implementations of language models and retrievers used for testing and development without external dependencies.
